title: Feed
about: The store's stream of what happened, and who follows it.

terms.meaning: the lowest factory level whose lines a subscription carries, and the level a factory is at least at for an agent's call to act on it (admission's scope).

a Normal line about a factory, `ConflictsPending`, labelled with it (`labels.factory`): written by the tick once when the factory's `ConflictsPending` condition turns True — its upgrade waiting on a person's choice for each conflict — its note the condition's message, and not again while it stays True, a reworded message included. A wait on a person, not a fault, and one of Nemia's selectors.

a Normal line about a factory, `ConflictsSettled`: written by the tick once when the factory's `ConflictsPending` condition, said pending on the feed, turns back to False — merged, or the version put back. A factory never said pending is never said settled.
a line a daemon writes once it has taken the store, naming its pid and how the one before it ended.

where the deliverer is with a subscription: the byte of the feed it has delivered or folded every line before, the routine lines folded and not yet said, and the subscription it was written for; kept beside the subscription's file and checked by the model's `Delivery` on every write.

a line about a factory itself (`involved.kind` `Factory`, its name): its upgrade's conflicts pending or settled, read off the status its controller wrote, and sent on the feed's stream as a `factory` event.
the store's stream of what happened, written by the daemon alone, which the board and Nemia follow.
a byte offset of complete lines of the feed, from 0: where a read, or a subscription's news, starts.

the one way the feed is read and appended to: `FeedDoor`, one group `lines` (`end`, `read`, `cursorRefusal`, `append`), append-only; the files at the store's root a program is given, or a test's memory stand-in that keeps the lines as their bytes. It refuses a cursor at no line's boundary and a line the model's `FeedLine` refuses, writing nothing of that append. The fold a pass reads it by is its caller's (`emitFeed`), never the layer's.

a Normal line about the store, `LevelChanged`, labelled with its factory (`labels.factory`): written by the tick each time a factory's level in force changes — set, raised, or a raise ended by `--end` or by its end passing — its note the level in words, a raise with its end; a factory at `manual` the feed has said nothing of gets none. A person's deed, and one of Nemia's selectors.
one judged change of a run, a step, a daemon, the store or a factory, written on the feed: a report, never an input.

terms.meaning: the code a machine selects a line on, computed from typed state, never from a word: an `Awaiting*` family for a wait on a person (`AwaitingAnswer` with `via`), and `Waiting` with `on` for a wait on a thing. A former code is still read, on a line on disk and in a stored selector (`FORMER_REASONS`).

terms.meaning: a Warning line about a run, `RevisionsBehind`, written while a pinned run's next filing would take other revisions than its pins: its note names each kind and name behind, and it is written once per drift.
a line of one run, or of one of its steps, naming each by id.
a line of the store itself: its pause put or lifted, or a factory's level changed.
Nemia's subscription, `nemia`, is the orchestrator's own: it wakes her on the lines of the store's feed its selectors take.

the one way a program reads and writes the store's subscriptions and their deliveries, by `SubscriptionName`: a name taken is `Conflict`, one dropped that is not there `Missing`, and each write is checked by the model on every layer, the files under the store's root or a test's memory stand-in.
what a subscription's files are named after: a letter or a digit, then letters, digits, `-` and `_`.
`person` on a line that waits on a person: every reason of phase waiting, and `Failed` and `CheckFailed`, from the reason table alone (`PERSON_WAITS`), never from a note.
